Q1. Question Title: Will Estonian have discovered Astronomy by turn 90?
Resolution Criteria: Resolves YES if Estonian discovers Astronomy on any turn from 61 through 90 inclusive (an event on turn 90 itself counts). Resolves NO if it is not discovered by the end of turn 90.

Q2. Question Title: Will Sahrawi have a higher territory size than Brazzaville-Congolese at turn 150?
Resolution Criteria: Resolves YES if Sahrawi's territory size as recorded at the end of turn 150 is strictly greater than Brazzaville-Congolese's. Equal values resolve NO. The quantity is the same quantity the world report calls Territory.

Q3. Question Title: Will Sahrawi complete the Great Library by turn 120?
Resolution Criteria: Resolves YES if Sahrawi completes Great Library on any turn from 61 through 120 inclusive (an event on turn 120 itself counts). A great wonder can be completed only once per game, so this resolves NO if another civilization completes it, or if it is not completed by the end of turn 120.

Q4. Question Title: Will Guinean be eliminated (cease to exist as a civilization) by turn 150?
Resolution Criteria: Resolves YES if Guinean is eliminated on any turn from 61 through 150 inclusive (an event on turn 150 itself counts), meaning it ceases to exist as a civilization. Losing cities, losing the capital, or a civil war split without elimination resolve NO.

Q5. Question Title: Will Brazzaville-Congolese's government change at least 3 times by turn 150? (Anarchy counts as a form of government, for this question.)
